title: Ptidej
summary: The Ptidej Tool Suite is a Java-based framework for identifying, analyzing, and improving design patterns and architectural quality in object-oriented programs, including a PADL C++ parser and UML model creators. Its vendored 'SDMetricsOpenCore' library is an unrelated third-party UML software-metrics tool (SDMetrics by Jürgen Wüst) that only shares a name with the SDV-family sdmetrics package and has no actual connection to it.
evidence: PADL Creator XMI/lib/SDMetricsOpenCore/src/com/sdmetrics – a Java UML metrics tool unrelated to SDV's sdmetrics package
needs: Confirm SDMetricsOpenCore is the unrelated Java UML tool (SDMetrics by J. Wüst), not SDV's sdmetrics; no code patterns matched SDV usage.
